description: Docker / container image handling: pin digests and group updates.

packageRules.description: Pin digests for all Docker images for reproducible builds
Group Docker digest-only updates into a single PR

A Python base-image minor (3.14 -> 3.15) is a new interpreter, not a routine update: compiled dependencies often have no wheel for it yet, so the image build fails while tests (pinned to their own python-version) still pass. Raise it alone and never auto-merge it. The container build is path-filtered and not a required check, so auto-merge does not wait for it - which is how finances, career and repo-agent all shipped an unbuildable 3.15 image.
